differences.what: A module, exam_peripheral_vascular, that the General note type includes: its section Peripheral vascular shows only while Peripheral Vascular (exam.systems is peripheral_vascular) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal.
differences.why: PRD main 414; forms 6.3; focused-exam inventory default 10

differences.what: The guidance line is not typed.

Pulses is a grid with a row for each pulse site (lines 9 to 19), recorded for the right and the left (sides), each cell choose-one from the shared list pulse_scale: 0, 1+, 2+, 3+, Unable to assess. Normal fills 2+.
differences.why: PRD main 414; focused-exam inventory default 1, 23, 28; forms 4.3

differences.what: 4+ is not a pulse grade: the one pulse scale stops at 3+.
Extremity findings is choose-many. Warm is the normal option; it does not clear the others, and it excludes Cool.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory 3.11, default 13, 17, 25, 26; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): Warm is kept with Edema and the rest rather than cleared by them

differences.what: Capillary refill: _____ seconds is a number, Capillary refill time, in seconds from 0 to 10 with one decimal. Normal leaves it empty.
The two refill bullets are a choose-one, Capillary refill, from the shared list capillary_refill, whose normal option is Less than 2 seconds. Neither field is worked out from the other.
Vascular symptoms is choose-many, with no normal option.
Temperature change (Oct 19) stays an option and, while picked, shows a choose-one, Temperature change: Warm or Cool.
